entities.name: Query protein Nnr
observations: 489 aa soluble-looking protein; estimated molecular mass 49.84 kDa, theoretical pI 5.81, predicted charge at pH 7 −8.33.
Pfam detects YjeF_N (PF03853) at residues 32–187 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) at residues 248–474.
Sequence matches reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes at 33.2–37.2% identity over 93.9–95.9% query coverage; strongest hit Q2RGI2 has E-value 9.8e−66.
Likely catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX, repairing hydrated NADH/NADPH.
Homolog annotations report one bound K+ per subunit; exact cofactor binding and catalytic activity remain homology-based for this query sequence.
Likely participates in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism; no transmembrane or signal-peptide evidence was reported.

entities.name: Q2RGI2
observations: Reviewed Moorella thermoacetica bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr; 37.2% identity and 95.9% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136, K+ cofactor, NAD(P)HX epimerase activity, and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity.

entities.name: YjeF_N PF03853
observations: Detected in the query sequence at residues 32–187 with i-Evalue 7.7e−43; corresponds to the N-terminal module of characterized Nnr proteins.

entities.name: Carb_kinase PF01256
observations: Detected in the query sequence at residues 248–474 with i-Evalue 3.6e−48; corresponds to the C-terminal catalytic-like module found in the Nnr homolog evidence.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair reactions
observations: Reference Nnr proteins catalyze epimerization of (6R)-NAD(P)HX to (6S)-NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX to NAD(P)H/NAD(P)H plus AMP and phosphate.
